_meta.title: Castle Clash — complete stat-stacking chain (rulebook)
_meta.master_formula: effective = base*(1 + sum(talent%)/100) + sum(flat system contributions)
_meta.base_formula: base = perStar*Stars + inc*(Level-1)   [Hero.data, per evolution tier evo 0/1/2]
order_of_operations: 1. base HP/ATK = perStar*Stars + inc*(Level-1)  (from live_hero_master.json tiers).
2. multiply base by (1 + sum(talent%)/100)  -- talents/traits apply to BASE ONLY, additive among themselves.
3. ADD flat per-level system contributions (inscription, soularms, soul, ...).
4. derived stats: CRIT% = crit*10000/(crit+1000); CRIT dmg mult = 1.5 + critdmg*1e-4; dmg_reduce = 1 - stat*1e-4.

stat_field_glossary.Tenacity: CRIT Resist (game 坚韧; see ResTip 'CRIT Resist Boost')
stat_field_glossary.Crit: raw CRIT stat -> CRIT% via crit*10000/(crit+1000)

validation.DOCUMENTED_not_cross_validated: crest, insignia, gear, breakthrough, holy, pet, destiny, faction -- extracted from live tables, application rule inferred; MCP accepts crest/gear params but does NOT fold them into stats yet.

inscription.note: table also carries Hp; MCP applies ATK only

soularms.note: multiple soularms items share levels; MCP-canonical = first series, Lv10 ATK 380

talents.source: MCP talent resolver + TD_HeroTalent.json (ability talents 'Base ATK +X%')
talents.note: trait % applies to BASE only; e.g. MCP talent 'Tenacity' L10 -> HP +230%

crest.note: each crest variant also grants a % skill via SkillId (e.g. 'Tenacity Crest' -> +10% HP)

insignia.note: each insignia/rune variant also grants a % skill (e.g. 'Tenacity Insignia' -> +10% HP)

faction.note: applies to all heroes of that faction
